title: 第一卷 第26章 那个男人站稳脚跟了
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
张秋月犯嘀咕，难道李华说带张春妮去礁石滩，然后让张春妮受伤，是在骗她？

    “不行，我得去问问。”

    张秋月赶紧往张春妮家里走。

    张春妮家在村子最里面。

    就在山脚下。

    偏僻。

    路又不好走。

    都是小路，路边枝枝蔓蔓不少，她刚买的新裙子还没穿几次，正宝贝着，担心被刮坏。

    好不容易走到地方，结果张春妮家没有人。

    张秋月正骂娘，隔壁有人听到动静出来看，说张春妮奶奶身子不舒服，张春妮带着人去村医那边挂水。

    张秋月嘴里嘟嘟囔囔的离开。

    到了诊所。

    抬眼就看到屋门口，一个老太太坐在椅子上正在挂水，张春妮蹲在旁边，正在和老太太说些什么。

    阳光洒在她身上，白的好似在发光。

    张秋月眼中满是嫉妒。

    她和张春妮就相差几天出生，所以从小就被人说来比较，无论是哪方面，她都比不过张春妮。

    要是最后嫁人，还是不如张春妮，那她这辈子都翻不了身。

    所以。

    她是绝对不会让张春妮如愿嫁人。

    她打听过了。

    那人家里是开工厂的，很有实力。

    这么有实力的家庭，要嫁也是她嫁过去。

    张秋月心里想着事，走到跟前，喊道：“喂。”

    张春妮扭头看到她，招呼道：“秋月，你怎么来了？”

    张秋月：“我听村里人说你赶海赚了很多钱？”

    张春妮：“也……也没有很多。”

    张秋月：“说说怎么赚的？”

    张春妮说道：“在礁石滩抓了很多海参。”

    张秋月明知故问：“谁带你去的？”

    张春妮脸一红，磕巴起来：“李……李华。”

    张秋月“哦”了一声，说道：“他啊，他为什么带你去赶海？”

    “你们什么关系？”

    “他……”

    一个又一个问题，就像是炮弹一样朝着张春妮发射。

    张春妮微微张着嘴，根本不知道该怎么回答。

    张秋月咄咄逼人：“你怎么不说话？”

    “难道是有什么难言之隐吗？”

    听到这话。
content_en:
Zhang Qiuyue muttered, was Li Hua lying to her when he said he took Zhang Chuni to the reef beach and then let Zhang Chuni get injured?

    "No, I have to ask."

    Zhang Qiuyue hurried to Zhang Chunni's house.

    Zhang Chunni's home is at the back of the village.

    Just at the foot of the mountain.

    remote.

    The road is not easy to walk.

    They were all small roads with lots of branches and vines on the side of the road. She had not worn the new dress she had just bought a few times and was wearing it, fearing it would get scratched.

    After finally walking to the place, there was no one in Zhang Chunni's house.

    Zhang Qiuyue was cursing her mother when someone next door heard the noise and came out to see her. They said that Zhang Chunni's grandma was not feeling well. Zhang Chunni took someone to the village doctor to get some water.

    Zhang Qiuyue left muttering.

    Arrived at the clinic.

    When I looked up, I saw an old lady sitting on a chair at the door of the house, hanging water. Zhang Chuni was squatting next to her, talking to the old lady.

    The sun shone on her body, and her white body seemed to be glowing.

    Zhang Qiuyue's eyes were filled with jealousy.

    She and Zhang Chuni were born just a few days apart, so they have been compared since they were young. No matter what aspect, she cannot compare to Zhang Chuni.

    If she is still not as good as Zhang Chunni when she finally gets married, she will never be able to turn around in her life.

    so.

    She would never let Zhang Chuni get married as she wished.

    She asked.

    That man's family runs a factory and he is very powerful.

    For such a powerful family, it was her choice to marry into it.

    Zhang Qiuyue was thinking about something, walked up to him and shouted: "Hey."

    Zhang Chuni turned around to see her and greeted, "Qiuyue, why are you here?"

    Zhang Qiuyue: "I heard from the villagers that you made a lot of money by going to sea?"

    Zhang Chunni: "Also... not many."

    Zhang Qiuyue: "Tell me how you make money?"

    Zhang Chuni said: "I caught a lot of sea cucumbers on the reef beach."

    Zhang Qiuyue asked knowingly: "Who took you there?"

    Zhang Chunni blushed and stuttered: "Li...Li Hua."

    Zhang Qiuyue said "Oh" and said, "He, why did he take you to catch the sea?"

    "What's your relationship?"

    "He..."

    Question after question was fired at Zhang Chuni like cannonballs.

    Zhang Chunni opened her mouth slightly, not knowing how to answer.

    Zhang Qiuyue said aggressively: "Why don't you speak?"

    "Is there something unspeakable?"

    Hear this.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 26 The man has established his footing
